description: Price a generation before starting it: the credits this model would charge for these options, and whether the current balance covers it. Uses the same validation and price calculation as generate_3d and generate, so for a valid request the figure is exactly what is charged. Omit scene to price every scene of the model. Nothing is charged and nothing is started.

options.description: The options you intend to pass; they change the price.

scene.description: A scene id from list_models, e.g. 'image-to-3d'.

name: estimate_cost

affordable.description: Whether the current balance covers it.

credits.description: The total this request would be charged: per output × outputs.

exact.description: True when the request is valid as sent, so generate would charge exactly this. False when it would be refused (input_issue says why); the figure is then what it costs once fixed.

title: Estimate credit cost
